entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain, and amounts may approach warning criteria, including spillover into the headwaters of the Canterbury lakes and rivers within 15 km east of the main divide. Note: rain may turn to snow above 800 metres overnight Sunday and before dawn Monday. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate. Changes: Watch area has been extended southwards.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 140 to 200 mm of rain about the ranges, and 60 to 90 mm of rain elsewhere. Peak intensities of 15 to 25 mm/h Sunday afternoon and evening. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: Watch for Nelson Lakes upgraded to an Orange Warning.
